task.question: What operation was involved in the United States seizing tankers in January 2026?
task.evidence: January 7 – The United States seizes two shadow fleet tankers, including one under a Russian flag, in the United States oil blockade during Operation Southern Spear.
task.sonnet_answer: The seizure of tankers in January 2026 was part of US enforcement of sanctions on Iranian oil, connected to the maximum pressure campaign against Iran. The specific operation name I'm not certain of — this may be beyond my reliable knowledge cutoff details.

answer: In January 2026, the United States, under Operation Southern Spear, seized two oil tankers linked to Venezuela: the Russian-flagged vessel Marinera and the Panama-flagged M Sophia. The operation involved US military and Coast Guard forces, and was aimed at enforcing sanctions on Venezuelan oil trade amidst escalating tensions with Russia. The seizures occurred in international waters, with US officials confirming there was no Russian interference during these operations. FINAL: Operation Southern Spear.

As part of Operation Southern Spear, the United States enacted a blockade on sanctioned oil tankers traveling in and out of Venezuela on 17 December 2025, after placing additional sanctions affecting oil trade with the country. The United States European Command (EUCOM) announced on 7 January 2026, that Marinera had been seized by the USCG cutter Munro in the Atlantic Ocean waters between Iceland and Scotland, traveling northward and eastward; an unnamed US official told The Washington Post that the vessel was secure and the Russians had not interfered with the seizure. On 7 January 2026, US Southern Command (USSOUTHCOM) announced that it had seized the oil tanker M Sophia (IMO number 9289477) in the Caribbean Sea. It described the vessel as a "stateless, sanctioned dark fleet motor tanker". M Sophia was flying a Panamanian flag and reportedly had its transponder off for approximately five months before being seized. Unnamed US officials indicated on 28 January t
On 9 January, USSOUTHCOM announced that it had seized MV Olina (IMO number 9282479) in the Caribbean in a joint operation with the USCG. The oil tanker was reported to be flying the false flag of Timor-Leste and left Venezuela fully loaded with sanctioned oil. The seizure was carried out by sailors and marines from USS Gerald R. Ford. After Trump stated the vessel's departure from Venezuela was unauthorized, and Olina had been seized "in coordination with the interim authorities of Venezuela", PDVSA announced the tanker was being returned to Venezuela as part of a joint operation with the US. Trump said: "The oil will be sold through the GREAT Energy Deal, which we have created for such sales".
On 15 January 2026, USSOUTHCOM announced it had seized Veronica (IMO number 9256860), a crude oil tanker, in the Caribbean. They said the ship was in defiance of Trump's "quarantine of sanctioned vessels". While the oil tanker was sailing under the flag of Guyana, the International Maritime Organization's database indicated it was previously registered in Russia under different names.

In January 2026, the United States, under Operation Southern Spear, seized two oil tankers linked to Venezuela: the Russian-flagged vessel Marinera and the Panama-flagged M Sophia. The operation involved US military and Coast Guard forces, and was aimed at enforcing sanctions on Venezuelan oil trade amidst escalating tensions with Russia. The seizures occurred in international waters, with US officials confirming there was no Russian interference during these operations. FINAL: Operation Southern Spear.
